# Ædelmetaller i porteføljen - sådan griber du det an

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-16  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode (Euroinvestor) is mostly about gold and silver. Commodity investor Erik Borg and technical analyst Lars Persson both say gold is a long-term insurance asset but is weak in the short term. Gold is drifting just under USD 4,000 and down about 10% this year, and silver is down about 33%. Both panelists will wait until gold consolidates above 4,000 before buying gold, silver or mining stocks again. Lars is also still lukewarm on Novo Nordisk despite its CagriSema data, and the episode touches on cyber risk, NVIDIA earnings and Anthropic's upcoming listing.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars is not a fan despite the CagriSema data; he wants momentum and is considering selling his recently rebought position.

#### Reasoning

Host-panel technical analyst Lars Persson says Novo lacks the momentum and uptrend he wants. The stock has hovered around 300 since February, and the rally that made him buy back in over the summer faded. He would not be a real buyer now and may sell into any rise to rotate into other stocks. Weekend CagriSema data (21% weight loss at 68 weeks) gives some support, but he still calls it rubber-band trading.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the stock rises, Lars may sell to rotate elsewhere
- continued lack of momentum around 300

> *"Nej, jeg vil gerne have noget mere fart, hvis jeg skulle være rigtig køber."*

---

### 🟠 NEM — Newmont | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Holding above its June-July bottom (90-100) thanks to strong earnings, but tracking gold lower.

#### Reasoning

Lars notes that Newmont has done better than gold and silver because miner earnings have been very strong, so it has not fallen back to its summer bottom. It still follows the gold price, which is falling. Both panelists want gold to consolidate above 4,000 before getting back into gold exposure.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below the June-July bottom around 90-100
- gold failing to hold 4,000

> *"Den er så ikke under bunden fra juni-juli, som vi så."*

---

### ⛔ AG — First Majestic Silver | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Pure silver miner trading below its August bottom, fully correlated with silver, which is down 33% this year.

#### Reasoning

Lars points out that First Majestic has broken below its prior bottom along with silver. Silver is down 33% this year and moves about three times as hard as gold. Erik will not touch silver until gold consolidates above 4,000.

> *"Der ligger den her Majestic, der hedder AG, den ligger faktisk også lavere end det."*

---

### 🟠 GDX — VanEck Vectors Gold Miners ETF | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Erik will re-enter gold and silver miners once gold consolidates above 4,000 for a few weeks; he says now is not the time.

#### Reasoning

Guest Erik Borg is out of gold and silver after selling at the January peak near 5,600. He explicitly waits for gold to consolidate above USD 4,000 for several weeks before buying gold and silver miners again. Headwinds are a strong dollar and rising rates; central bank buying (China, Poland, Turkey) is long-term support.

#### Sell Triggers

- gold fails to consolidate above 4,000
- stronger dollar and rising rates
- geopolitical stabilisation reduces safe-haven demand

> *"jeg vil meget gerne se den konsolidere over 4.000 i nogle uger, for jeg vil ind igen"*

---
